content.content:
# Figma mirror: tools and backups

> **2026-10-20: Figma is retired and out of date.** The two Claude artifacts are now the up-to-date JusPrin
> design. Do NOT re-sync them from Figma: that would overwrite newer design work. Edit them directly:
> copy the live files into `work/` (or read them with the Artifact tool), change them, publish only the changed
> files, then rsync `work/` into `published/`. Remember the canvas keeps its own copy of the design system in
> `project/ds/jusprin/` (tokens and component styles): change both artifacts together. `tools/composer/` holds
> the scripts used since then (`render.py` screenshots boards with headless Chrome; `resize_board.py` fixes a
> board's height in its file and in `canvas.json`; `build_filament_step.py` draws the Add-a-printer step-3 boards and their spec files, `measure_sheets.py` measures their sheet heights with headless Chrome). Before publishing to either artifact, do a plain `read` of its url: a publish after only `path` reads is refused as "haven't viewed the latest version". The Figma re-sync steps below are kept as history.


This folder keeps what is needed to re-sync two Claude artifacts with the Figma file "JusPrin v2"
(file key `jo9J1sK9ZZ0vxncWnSp0vH`), and to prove a re-sync breaks nothing.

- Canvas "JusPrin v2": https://claude.ai/artifact/VCEppdwfT7v32W4beUxL1v
- JusPrin Design System: https://claude.ai/artifact/3zgiix8rAw3rXextQnR5UL

It lives outside the JusPrin repo on purpose: it is not product code, and untracked files in the repo mean
"unfinished work" there.

## What is here

- `published/` — an exact copy of what is published now (`canvas/project`, `ds/project`). Every re-sync is
  compared against it, then it is replaced by the new build.
- `figma/spec3/<page id>.txt` — the Figma pages as last read (one text line per layer). `figma/vars.json` —
  Figma's variables, text styles and shadows as last read.
- `tools/` — the scripts (below).
- `visual/figma/*.png` — Figma's own screenshot of each page, used to score the artboards.
  `visual/scores-*.json` — the scores before and after the 2026-10-13 re-import.
- `backup-2026-10-13-before-reimport/` — the published files, the Figma reads and the scripts as they were
  before the re-import of 2026-10-13. Running those scripts on those reads reproduces those files byte for byte.

## Re-sync, step by step

1. Read Figma. For each page id (`0:1 1423:396 320:1053 160:59 9:153 359:116 1148:1287 1258:396 1328:2780`)
   call the Figma tool `use_figma` with the text of `tools/spec3_min.js`, replacing `__PAGE__` and `__OFFSET__`
   (0, then 20200, 40400, ... while the offset is below the returned `total`). About 35 calls; have background
   agents make them, because each reply is large. Run `tools/vars.js` once the same way and save its result as
   `figma/vars.json`. The script source is `tools/figma_spec3.js`; `python3 tools/minify.py tools/figma_spec3.js
   tools/spec3_min.js` rebuilds the one-line version.
2. Decode the replies from the session transcripts:
   `SESSION=<session id> OUT=figma python3 tools/collect.py`
3. Build into a scratch folder `new/`:

       export FIGMA_DIR=$PWD/figma DS_DIR=$PWD/new/ds REPO=/Users/kenneth/Projects/JusPrin
       rm -rf new && mkdir new && cp -R published/ds new/ds
       python3 tools/build_variants.py $REPO new/ds
       python3 tools/build_canvas.py $REPO new/canvas <design system version id>
       mkdir -p new/specs/project/screens && cp published/ds/project/tokens.json new/specs/project/
       python3 tools/specs.py $REPO figma/spec3 new/specs/project/screens

4. Compare with what is published: `python3 tools/compare_builds.py published new`. With no change in Figma and
   no change in the scripts, every line must say "identical". Explain every file that is not before publishing.
5. Compare with Figma itself: take a screenshot of each Figma page (`get_screenshot`, maxDimension 8000) into
   `visual/figma/`, then `tools/visual_pages.py`, screenshot each `composite-<page>.html` at full page size,
   and `tools/visual_compare.py`. No artboard may score worse than in `visual/scores-after.json`.
6. Publish only the changed files to the same artifact URLs, check the live pages, then replace `published/`.

## Known limits

Photographs and 3D renders are flat placeholders. Artwork over 64px is not drawn. The page Figma marks obsolete
is not read. Radial and image fills are placeholders (linear gradients are drawn). Figma stacks some dark screens
on top of light ones on "Printer & Material Settings"; the canvas keeps Figma's stacking.

## Versions before the setup-card rework (2026-10-26)

The artifact service keeps every published version and the Artifact tool can copy a file from an earlier version by its id (`files: {"<path>": {"artifact": "<url>", "path": "<path>", "ver": "<id>"}}`), so a rollback is one publish from the version named here, with no copy made by hand. It cannot list versions, which is why they are written down here before each publish.

- Canvas "JusPrin v2", live version before the rework: `1793028883-97c8` (its `project/canvas.json` sha256 fa8090af…).
- Design System, live version before the rework: `1793028854-832b`.
- After the rework: Design System `1793030084-f2a5` (files in `1793030067-e6e3`, index in `1793030084-f2a5`), canvas `1793030147-f30a`. Both publishes carry the label "Setup card two-part shape (2026-10-26)". The generator is `tools/composer/setup_card_lib.py` (card markup, spec lines, the coded component's source) driven by `tools/composer/build_setup_card_rework.py`; its work copies are in `work-setup-card/`. `tools/bundle.src.*` and `tools/index.src.d.ts` were refreshed from the published bundle at the same time.
- Facts line wraps (same day, Kenneth's option 1 from the canvas comment): Design System `1793050539-3543` (files in `1793050526-0faf`), canvas `1793050614-59a7`, label "Setup card facts line wraps (2026-10-26)". Before it: Design System `1793042480-936b`, canvas `1793049870-34ae`.
- Agent pane conversation read at Body (Kenneth, 2026-10-26; code commit 384cfb0f90 on jusprin-newui): before it, Design System `1793050539-3543`, canvas `1793053249-eee9` (canvas.json sha256 a37d7c75…). The board pass is `tools/composer/chat_text_step_up.py` (specs: `chat_text_step_up_specs.py`), frames that would clip grow with `grow_frames.py`, preview card heights move with `measure_previews.py`; work copies are in `work-chat-text/`. After it: Design System `1793056450-4eee` (files) and `1793056466-4559` (lastChange), canvas `1793056610-f459`.
- Prepare header gear menu (Kenneth, 2026-10-27, decided in a side session): on the current canvas (https://claude.ai/artifact/ENCtdaz7gjynfbcy4JYbWJ), before `1793143270-86c0`, after `1793143597-61ea`, label "Prepare header gear menu (2026-10-27)". New board `main-10-prepare-header-gear-menu.dc.html` (Main Page, under home-first-run) with an orange sticky `prepare-header-open-item` beside it; `prefs-13-entry-points.dc.html` "In a project" stage redrawn with the gear. Work copies in `work-gear-menu/`. The full-screen Prepare boards still draw the ⋯ button; not swept.
- Same board, one appearance mode (2026-10-27, later): design-system.md "Design handoff requirements" rule 1 (one canonical mode per screen, no paired light/dark frames) applied; the dark strip removed, board 1280×444. Before `1793145257-9f52` (another session had added a Print history page meanwhile; the live index is now minified), after `1793145513-c889`, label "Gear menu board: one appearance mode (2026-10-27)". The watch on the canvas stays off in that session.

"""Screenshot canvas boards with headless Chrome. Usage: render.py <canvas project dir> <out dir> <board.dc.html>..."""
import json, re, shutil, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
proj, out = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2])
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(out / 'fonts').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for f in Path('/Users/kenneth/Projects/JusPrin/src/slic3r/GUI/JusPrin/WebShared/fonts').glob('HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_*_latin.woff'):
    shutil.copy(f, out / 'fonts' / f.name)
shutil.copy(proj / 'ds/jusprin/tokens.css', out / 'tokens.css')
shutil.copy(proj / 'ds/jusprin/components/bundle.css', out / 'bundle.css')
boards = json.loads((proj / 'canvas.json').read_text())['boards']
chrome = '/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome'
for name in sys.argv[3:]:
    s = (proj / name).read_text()
    body = s[s.index('</helmet>') + 9:s.index('</x-dc>')]
    m = re.search(r'"\$preview":\{"width":(\d+),"height":(\d+)\}', s)
    w, h = (int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))) if m else (boards[name]['w'], boards[name]['h'])
    page = out / (name + '.html')
    page.write_text(f'<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><link rel="stylesheet" href="tokens.css"><style>body{{margin:0}}</style></head><body>{body}</body></html>')
    png = out / (name.replace('.dc.html', '') + '.png')
    subprocess.run([chrome, '--headless=new', '--disable-gpu', '--no-first-run', '--user-data-dir=/tmp/claude/render-profile', '--hide-scrollbars', f'--window-size={w},{h}', '--force-device-scale-factor=1',
                    f'--screenshot={png}', page.as_uri()], check=True, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
    print(png)

# Onboarding group: sweep report

Boards checked: 29 (the list in groups/onboarding.txt). Changed: 23. Nothing to change: 6.
No board in this group is a question board or a deliberate "before" drawing.

## 1. Changed

**The welcome and its sign-in steps**: first-run-welcome-01, first-run-welcome-02, first-run-04, 05, 12, 13, 14, 15 and 16. Each board draws the same welcome column.
- "Show it a photo of what went wrong. The agent reads your file, …" → "Show it a photo of what went wrong. AI reads your file, …" (decision 1; the code changed this in d7975301fd)
- "Sign up to use the AI agent, or skip it and just slice." → "Sign up to use AI, or skip it and just slice." (decision 1, d7975301fd)
- Only on 01 and 02, where the offer is drawn at rest: "Good for your first month. That's about 100 messages to the agent." → "Good for your first month: about 500 Standard or 100 Expert messages." (decision 4)
- I left the headline "The AI slicer that fixes failed prints." alone. The code's "…that helps you get better prints." comes only from 7bbc1f8154. I also left 05 showing the doors after sign-in, because hiding them is likewise only in 7bbc1f8154.
- first-run-06 imports welcome-01 as its background, so it picks up these changes without an edit.

**Your printer step**: first-run-08 and first-run-18.
- "Ask the agent" (link after "Can't find your printer?") → "Ask AI" (decision 1, PrinterPickerHost.tsx)

**Home after first launch**: first-run-09 and first-run-10.
- 09 and 10: the group label "AGENT" → "AI" (decision 1, AgentGroup.tsx)
- 10: "Set up the agent" → "Set up AI" (decision 1)
- 10: "Get 500 free credits and ask the agent to fix failed prints." → "Get 500 free credits and ask AI to fix failed prints." (decision 1, d7975301fd. The code's "…to improve your prints" is only in 7bbc1f8154, so I didn't use it.)

**The map**: first-run-11. It names screen text, so I updated what it quotes.
- "Straight to Your printer. The agent can be set up later from Home." → "Straight to Your printer. AI can be set up later from Home." (1)
- "Can't find your printer? Ask the agent" → "Can't find your printer? Ask AI" (1)
- "Only when the agent is set up. … and the agent adds it." → "Only when AI is set up. … and AI adds it." (1)
- "Set up the agent with the same three doors, and No printer yet (10)." → "Set up AI with the same three doors, and No printer yet (10)." (1)

**File › Import from OrcaSlicer**: orca-import-01 to 05. These five boards draw a chat behind the dialog.
- In that chat's change list: "… · Agent · 06:03" → "… · AI · 06:03", and "Agent · 06:04" → "AI · 06:04" (decision 1, ChangeRows.tsx)

**credits-01a** (Preferences › Account over Home)
